notes.title: Best rewards. Major update: multilingual version launched
notes.content:
Update content:
1. Mainly optimized for compatibility issues with A card

2. A multilingual trial version has been updated, without any updates to the storyline content. It only replaces the video without subtitles and cheats multilingual subtitle files. Due to translation cost limitations, we have adopted Chat Gpt for translation in multiple languages, which may result in inaccurate translations. The production team will optimize the translation based on their own foreign language learning situation in the future.

3. The list of production personnel thanks the first batch of players who participated in the second creation (it is your participation that gave us greater confidence! Thank you for coming and giving us the warmest beam of light in the long night!)

notes.title: "Game of Fame" was officially launched on February 20
notes.content:
[h2] The entire production team of "Game of Fame" would like to thank every "Mr. Lu" who supports us and wish everyone a happy old age. [/h2]

At the same time, there are twists and turns, shortcomings, and disappointments along the way. Of course, there will also be beauty, surprises, and touching moments. Between love and hate, we insist on choosing to do our best to explore how to make products that users like more.

At the beginning of the story, we welcome Mr. Lu to join the fan group and give positive feedback on product bugs and experience. We will go all out to respond and deal with all problems, and we will definitely live up to Mr. Lu’s cultivation. We are committed to allowing you to experience an interesting life journey in your own leisure time. We have always thought that this would be a cool thing (^^). After all, “art appreciation is never-ending.”

Finally, I wish everyone a happy game.

Communication group: 419349367

"Game of Fame" development team
2024.02.20

notes.title: Sorry, we are postponed
notes.content:
Dear all players who follow "Game of Fame", I'm sorry, we are not done yet.
After careful consideration, we have decided to postpone the sale for 7 days.
All the partners in the studio cherish the product's reputation and care about the players' experience. We feel very guilty for making such a decision and failing everyone's expectations. I hope to gain a little understanding and patience from everyone. They all say that good things come only in time. I believe this decision will bring us a better encounter.
Looking forward to seeing you all soon! ! We also announced that the price of our game is 45 yuan, with a 12% discount on the first launch, and the discounted price is 39.6 yuan.
To express our apology, we will dynamically draw some prizes at Station B. The prizes are as follows:
1. One signed still photo of the designated main character, a total of three places
2. 20 game activation codes
For details, please pay attention to Station B: Game of Fame and Fortune
ORZ solemnly apologizes again!

"Game of Fame" development team

notes.title: Is "Game of Fame" over? Or raging? Demo is open for trial play
notes.content:
[h1]We are very excited (rubbing hands) to announce that the "Game of Vanity" demo will debut on the Steam platform on February 2! [/h1]

This game will take you into a life growth story full of choices and turns, showing a "Palu" who works hard in the real society and makes difficult choices on the road to success.

Come on, choose your life path! (smiles and rubs hands together)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828527/482d47aff0d695b17bf41db2b2d357e2d2f7fce7.png[/img]

[h2] Either stop early and return to calm;
Or race all the way and become a devil. [/h2]

"Game of Fame and Fortune" allows you to deeply experience the life journey of the protagonist Lu Yuan. From a fledgling youth to a mature and successful person, you will witness how power, money, and reputation shape a person's destiny. In this world full of decisions and tests of humanity, your choices will affect the fate of you and those around you.

The focus of the game is on presenting complex social relationships and moral dilemmas. You will face countless difficult choices: Should you sacrifice your personal relationships for professional success? Or do you choose secret means to fight injustice? How you navigate the ocean of life depends entirely on your decisions.

[h2]Looking forward to your participation and experiencing this exciting journey of life! [/h2]

[h2]The following is what the production team wants to say:[/h2]
The original intention of making this game was because I watched a very popular TV series in early 2023. I was deeply attracted by the line from the fish seller in the play, "The bigger the storm, the more expensive the fish." So I suddenly thought that if there was an interactive game where I could control my life and become a big brother step by step, it would be very "interesting". In order to make such a game, we are doing our best to polish it from script to shooting to development. I hope that it can bring you a "refreshing" experience in the end. I also hope that the interactive film and television game industry can continue to flourish and more and more good works will appear.
​
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828527/7bc8e3ff45f09406d44fe0849f1054429eea094d.png[/img]

[h2]Add to wishlist and follow, never get lost in life[/h2]
